Container.Name: platter-bridge
Container.Overview: Optional home side for Platter, the desktop music player for Plex. While no computer has Platter open, the Bridge catches up with Lidarr: it scans just the folders of new downloads, keeps protected albums out of Lidarr's way and, with the music folder mounted read-write, adds new protected albums the way Platter would. Platter works fully without it. It opens no ports and talks to Platter only through a sealed relay. Pair it once: in Platter, Settings > Bridge > Pair a Bridge, then paste the code below.
Container.Requires: Platter on a computer, open while you pair (once).

Config.Name: Pair code
Config.Description: From Platter: Settings > Bridge > Pair a Bridge. Works once, within an hour, while Platter is open.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Where the Bridge keeps its pairing and state.

Config.Name: Music folder
Config.Description: Optional. Your music folder. Leave it read-only and additions wait for a computer; make it read-write (rw) and the Bridge adds new protected albums itself.

Config.Name: Plex's path for the music folder
Config.Description: Optional, with Music folder: the same folder as Plex sees it, like /data/media/Music.

Config.Name: Lidarr staging folder
Config.Description: Optional, with a read-write music folder: Lidarr's staging folder for protected artists.

Config.Name: Staging folder inside the container
Config.Description: Leave as /staging when you set the staging folder above.

Config.Name: Relay
Config.Description: Optional. Your own ntfy server instead of ntfy.sh (Platter must use the same one).
